yaml:
apiVersion: unified-cd/v1
kind: Job
metadata:
  name: edge-w4-reuse
spec:
  agentSelector:
    - kind:kubernetes
  podTemplate:
    reuse: true
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: job
          image: alpine:3.20
  steps:
    - name: identity
      run: echo "W4-REUSE-HOSTNAME=$(hostname)"
    - name: marker
      run: |
        if [ -f /workspace/w4-reuse-marker ]; then
          echo "W4-REUSE-MARKER=HIT planted=$(cat /workspace/w4-reuse-marker)"
        else
          echo "W4-REUSE-MARKER=MISS"
        fi
        date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ > /workspace/w4-reuse-marker
        echo "W4-REUSE-MARKER-PLANTED=$(cat /workspace/w4-reuse-marker)"
